headline: Ratchet & Clank tidies shared declarations without changing the game
summary: Four pull requests moved shared function declarations into headers and replaced compatible aliases with real names (#234, #235, #236, #237). The author reports unchanged output for every release. PAL v2.00 remains at 100.00% of code matched, with all 5,116 functions matching. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game.
highlights: Five headers and aliases with differing types or failed checks were left in place (#237).
